name: deriv_assessment_bronze_streaming_continuous
description: Always-on Auto Loader ingestion of the vendor deposit CSV and client-profile CDC JSONL feeds from the stream landing volume into Bronze. Single task by design: a continuous task never reaches a terminal state, so nothing can depend on it. Silver/Gold are driven by the file-arrival job in create_job_batch.json.

tasks.description: Two Auto Loader queries, micro-batching every minute. trigger_mode=continuous makes the notebook start both queries and then block on awaitAnyTermination, so a failure in either feed fails the run instead of leaving one feed silently stalled.
